adopt_command_surface.replay_observation: adopt uses the same mutate()/replay rule as post: an existing message_id with identical content returns the existing row, with different content is refused (adapter l.245-269). From the CLI, observed_at is always a fresh timestamp (adapter l.897) and there is no flag to supply it, so re-running the same adopt command with the same --message-id was refused with `message_id already exists with different content` (A2, exit 1; re-observed on the S2 adapter), even though every flag was identical. A gate or launcher that retries adopt with a fixed --message-id should expect exit 1 on the retry, not an idempotent success. Whether this is intended is not established.

This note's worker ran WaitDeliveryByToTest only; the full common check (92 tests OK, no skips, including BaseByteIdentityTest) was run at 845afa80 by the coordinator in the S2 worktree and by the tier-1 reviewer in a git clone (s2-confirm-findings.md). d10_delivery_by_to.row_unchanged: Rows are returned byte-unchanged; matching is reported only in `matches` (adapter l.658-659 D10 comment; returned rows taken from the stored list at l.676-677; test WaitDeliveryByToTest.test_returned_row_is_byte_unchanged at tests/test_codex_chatboard_contracts.py l.720).
d10_delivery_by_to.exclusions_before_matching: control: topics and exclude_session_id (unless wake is true) are applied before either path is tried (adapter l.661-665). W_excl: exclude_session_id equal to the poster's session removed the to-addressed row (status timeout, exit 2).
d10_delivery_by_to.control_prefix_ignored: addressed_to ignores any `to` address starting `control:session:` (adapter l.619-629, CONTROL_PREFIX l.30). post itself refuses a control: address in `to` (Pctl), so such a row exists only if stored directly. A wait on a control topic without the explicit binding is refused (W_ctl exit 1: `control topic requires the matching explicit session binding`). Control-address non-matching on a stored row was established from the code and the test test_control_topic_only_wait_gets_no_to_matches (test file l.808), not by a stored-row run of this worker.
d10_delivery_by_to.matched_by_use_for_gate: matched_by lets the gate keep its adoption test topic-only: ignore any row whose matched_by lacks "topic" (doc l.62-64).
d10_delivery_by_to.other_semantics: A stored `to` that is not a list of strings matches nothing by `to`; a row is delivered once however many paths match; --limit/next_since/has_more count matched rows (doc l.55-66).
